why: Un ensayo completo permite comprobar si la postura que parecía clara en una introducción resiste el desarrollo y las objeciones. Las ideas deben responder a todas las obligaciones, avanzar mediante razones y apoyo, y terminar en una conclusión compatible. Este caso crítico de preparación hacia 7.5+ exige valorar alcance, relevancia y precisión conjuntamente; ni la longitud ni una estructura concreta garantizan una banda.

decisions.cue: La consigna exige discutir ambas posturas y opinar.
decisions.action: Explica el argumento fuerte de cada lado antes de valorar condiciones.
decisions.en: Pedestrian streets can improve safety, but essential vehicle access still needs planning.
decisions.reason: Una valoración matizada puede integrar razones de ambas posturas.

decisions.cue: La consigna pregunta si las ventajas superan las desventajas.
decisions.action: Compara sus efectos y justifica cuál tiene mayor peso.
decisions.en: The benefit depends on reducing hours without expecting the same work to be done faster.
decisions.reason: Evaluar condiciones evita tratar una etiqueta como garantía de beneficio.

worked.scenario: Practicas una discusión original sobre el acceso de vehículos a las calles comerciales.
worked.task: Consigna original completa. Write at least 250 words. Some people think all cars should be banned from town-centre shopping streets. Others believe these streets should remain open to cars. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Give reasons and relevant examples to support your answer.
worked.model:
Whether cars should be allowed in town-centre shopping streets depends on how people use those streets. Supporters of a ban value safer, quieter public spaces, while opponents emphasise convenient access. I favour reducing ordinary traffic, but essential access should be maintained rather than treating every car journey in the same way.

Removing through traffic could make shopping areas more comfortable for pedestrians. People would be able to move between shops without repeatedly waiting to cross a busy road, and cafés could provide outdoor seating away from exhaust fumes. For example, a parent shopping with young children could concentrate on the children and the shops instead of constantly looking for approaching vehicles. These benefits are particularly valuable on narrow streets where there is little room to separate traffic from people.

However, keeping some vehicle access has a reasonable justification. A customer with limited mobility may be unable to carry purchases from a distant car park, and small businesses need deliveries that cannot always be brought in by hand. If a ban ignores these needs, it could make the centre less accessible despite improving conditions for many walkers. Supporters of continued access are therefore right to question a policy that simply closes every entrance without offering alternatives.

In my view, councils should prevent unnecessary through journeys while allowing controlled access for people who need it. Delivery periods outside the busiest shopping hours, accessible drop-off points and reliable public transport could address the main objections. The precise arrangement should reflect local street layouts rather than copy another town automatically.

Overall, a calmer shopping centre is a worthwhile aim, but a complete ban without practical exceptions would be too rigid. Restricting traffic while protecting essential access offers a more balanced response to the needs of shoppers and businesses.

reasoning.quote: Supporters of a ban value safer, quieter public spaces
reasoning.explanation: Anuncia una postura de la discusión y su razón, no solo su existencia.
Desarrolla una objeción concreta a la prohibición universal.

reasoning.quote: prevent unnecessary through journeys while allowing controlled access
reasoning.explanation: La opinión responde a la propuesta y se mantiene en la conclusión.

alternative.text: Cars should be banned because pedestrians matter; cars should also be allowed because businesses matter.
alternative.why: Nombrar dos intereses sin explicar su relación ni decidir cómo valorarlos deja la discusión y la postura incompletas.

checks.prompt: Caso crítico: tu ensayo explica seguridad peatonal, pero presenta la otra postura como Drivers are lazy. ¿Qué mejora responde a la tarea?
checks.explanation: Discutir ambas posturas exige razones pertinentes, no una caricatura.
options: Cambiar lazy por un sinónimo más formal manteniendo la misma afirmación.
Explicar una necesidad real de acceso y valorar cómo afecta a la prohibición.
Eliminar toda referencia a la segunda postura.

checks.prompt: Tu postura mantiene excepciones para entregas. Completa solo unnecessary o all: Councils should restrict ___ car journeys while preserving essential access.
checks.explanation: All contradiría preserving essential access; unnecessary conserva el alcance limitado.

checks.prompt: El cuerpo justifica restricciones con excepciones. ¿Qué conclusión mantiene la postura?
checks.explanation: Limitar el tráfico habitual y mantener acceso esencial conserva el beneficio buscado y el límite desarrollado. Prohibir sin excepciones o negar toda desventaja del tráfico contradice el argumento.
options: Ban every vehicle immediately, with no exceptions.
Keep every street unchanged because traffic has no disadvantages.
Limit ordinary traffic while retaining planned access for essential journeys.

retrieval.prompt: Nueva consigna original completa. Write at least 250 words. Some employers are considering a four-day working week with fewer total working hours and no reduction in pay. Do the advantages of this change outweigh the disadvantages? Give reasons and relevant examples to support your answer. Define el alcance de tu valoración y compara efectos, sin contar simplemente argumentos.
retrieval.explanation: Modelo original sin banda asignada. El ejemplo valora condiciones y compara efectos; otra postura puede funcionar si la sostienes con desarrollo relevante.
retrieval.model:
A four-day working week with fewer hours and unchanged pay could improve employees’ lives, but it also raises a practical question about how essential work will be completed. I believe the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages where employers reorganise work carefully. Introducing the change without considering workload and staffing would be much less convincing.

The main benefit is additional time away from work. An extra free day could allow employees to attend appointments, care for relatives or rest without sacrificing their income. This may be particularly helpful for people who currently use much of the weekend catching up on tasks that cannot be done during working hours. A less pressured routine could also make it easier to return to work ready to concentrate. The advantage therefore concerns a meaningful reduction in competing demands, rather than simply the attraction of a longer weekend.

However, fewer working hours can create serious difficulties for organisations that need continuous coverage. A small repair business, for example, may still receive calls throughout the week. If the same employees are absent for an additional day, customers could wait longer or the employer might need to hire more staff. Moreover, expecting workers to complete exactly the same workload in less time could increase stress and undermine the intended benefit.

These disadvantages deserve attention, but they do not make the proposal unsuitable everywhere. Employers could test staggered days off, remove unnecessary meetings and check whether service quality remains acceptable. In jobs where output depends mainly on being present for a fixed number of hours, additional staffing costs may make the change harder to justify.

Overall, I favour the shorter week when the reduction in hours is real and the organisation can maintain its service. Better personal time is a substantial advantage, but it outweighs the costs only when employees and customers are not expected to absorb those costs invisibly.
checklist: Respondo a outweigh con una comparación y valoración explícitas.
Respeto fewer total working hours y no describo solo comprimir las mismas horas.
Desarrollo beneficios y perjuicios con mecanismos y ejemplos pertinentes.
Mi condición de apoyo permanece consistente en introducción y conclusión.
Escribo al menos 250 palabras con referencias claras y lengua revisada.
